title: Polynomial encoding a binary vector
statement: For a certified binary field implementation of degree $\ell$ and a vector $\gamma\in(\mathbb{F}_2)^n$, define a polynomial over the field obtained by adjoining a root of the implementation's irreducible modulus: its coefficient of $X^{i+1}$ is the image of $\gamma_i$ under the natural field map, for each $i=0,\ldots,n-1$.
hypotheses_covered: a certified binary field implementation of degree $\ell$ is given
